nodes.label: Our Little Universe (couple app)
nodes.rationale: Private single-page relationship keepsake app for Ines and Alaedine: a shared dashboard, timeline, movie log, map, photo gallery, mood diary and private video-call room, all synced live through Firebase so both partners see the same data. Romantic themed UI (hearts, heartbeat SVG, Fraunces/Caveat fonts) is intentional emotional design.

nodes.label: toDisplayableImage() HEIC to JPEG
nodes.rationale: iPhone photos are HEIC, which browsers cannot display; converted client-side to JPEG before upload so both partners can view them.

nodes.label: WebRTC Together module
nodes.rationale: Peer-to-peer video/audio/screen-share so the couple can watch together remotely; Firebase Realtime DB is reused as the signaling channel (offer/answer/ICE/chat) to avoid running a dedicated server; TURN relay added for NAT traversal.

nodes.label: Firebase Realtime Database
nodes.rationale: Collections: storyEvents, movies, meetings, places, photos, moods, together/{room}. onValue listeners give real-time sync between the two partners with no custom backend.
